disclaimer: DiffSight reports differences found by automated image and text analysis. It does not claim 100% accuracy. Findings marked 'uncertain' have weaker evidence and should be checked by a person. Stamps, signatures and handwriting are compared by appearance only; no statement is made about who made a mark. Content that could not be read is reported as unreadable, never guessed.
